cohort: The study included 51 pregnant women diagnosed with intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy (40 mild, 11 severe) and 43 healthy pregnant women as controls.
finding: Melatonin and interleukin-10 levels were significantly lower, while interleukin-8 levels were significantly higher, in women with intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy compared to healthy pregnant women.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy, at the time of diagnosis of intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy or during a healthy pregnancy for controls.
